summary: bisect_left finds the insertion position before existing equal values in an ascending sequence.
documentation: bisect_left finds the insertion position before existing equal values in an ascending sequence. Items before that position are less than the target; later items are greater than or equal to it.
inputs: A sorted sequence and a target.
caution: The sequence must already be sorted. Finding the index does not insert anything, and list insertion still requires moving items.
scenarios: Locate the first position of a repeated price in a sorted list.
Find where a new measurement belongs in an ordered sample.
Determine a threshold boundary without scanning every prior value.
title: Find a left insertion point
problem: Input has values (an ascending list of integers) and target (an integer). Return the insertion index before any equal values. Do not change the list.
goal: Use bisect.bisect_left() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Use bisect_left on the existing sorted values.
